title: L. Moreno
summary: L. Moreno authored amendment AMD-SUP-2026-02 to the supplier policy for the Purchase department.
body:
L. Moreno is a member of Northbridge Cycles' Purchase department [^r1]. On 2026-08-14, Moreno authored [[amd-sup-2026-02|AMD-SUP-2026-02]] version 1.0, which amended the [[topic-un-38-3-certificates|UN 38.3 certificate]] rules in [[pol-sup-003|POL-SUP-003]] §4.4 [^r1].

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Name | L. Moreno |
| Department | Purchase |
| Known contributions | Author of AMD-SUP-2026-02 v1.0 |

## Role and contributions

L. Moreno authored version 1.0 of [[amd-sup-2026-02|AMD-SUP-2026-02]] on 2026-08-14 on behalf of the Purchase department [^r1]. This amendment updated the [[topic-un-38-3-certificates|UN 38.3 certificate]] compliance requirements defined in [[pol-sup-003|POL-SUP-003]] §4.4 [^r1].
